inclusion_rule: Studies that emit an acoustic signal (near-ultrasonic or ultrasonic, from a loudspeaker, earphone or transducer) and decode speech, silent speech or mouth state from its reflection or Doppler shift off the lips, face, jaw or vocal tract, captured by a microphone. Boundary: B-mode ultrasound tongue imaging, RF radar, Wi-Fi and laser sensing are excluded when read; reviews and datasets without a decoding result count as pattern matches only; versions of one study count once.
